changes: Design rework on PC and phone: a Light theme, five accent colours and four text sizes (Settings > Looks; Ctrl+Shift+L switches dark and light on a PC)
Home shows a welcome page until you sign in
Small tabs are pills, with sharper cards, tables and buttons
Every colour is checked to be readable in both themes
App debug log in the Request log: everything that happens in the app with its output, private things hidden
Forced update: Update now installs the update by itself (no GitHub page unless it fails)
Map opens by itself and looks up every loaded server, listing only the place you press
Game wiki button shows only for games that have a wiki
Friends in games show the friend's picture

Forced updates now work for every channel: an app counts the updates of its own channel, so a Beta app that missed two betas gets the 'Please update' page (it was only counting Stable releases, so nothing could ever be blocked)
Android: the phone's own 'Allow notifications?' question now also appears when you press Test on the Alerts page, and at start when alerts are on but the phone was never asked (at most twice)

New switch in Settings: servers are looked up by themselves (location, running time, version) as soon as they are listed, with no button to press. Needs one of the two location services allowed and a sign-in; off by default (PC and phone)
Mutual friends and since when you are friends, for any person in the friends, requests, followers, following and search lists (PC and phone)
Friend requests show when they were sent, where they came from and how many friends you share
Servers show the place version (marking older ones) and can copy a join link
Game wiki button, from RoSeal's list of game links: asked before RoSeal is contacted, links are checked before they open
Account page shows voice chat state and age verification; Money shows a Developer Exchange line
Servers: sort by ping, FPS, players, and by how long a server has been running; a Running for column
Location and uptime on a game's page, with a world map of where the servers are (PC and phone). It asks Roblox about each server the way the Play button does; nothing is joined
Locations come from RoSeal's list of Roblox data centres or from ipwho.is, and nothing is contacted until you agree (asked once, switches in Settings)
Backups are written safely (no half-written file)
Friend alerts: a notification when friends you pick come online or join a game (PC and phone), with a switch in Settings and a check of the system's own notification settings
Join requests of all your groups in one list, to accept or decline in bulk (PC and phone)
Backup and restore of your settings, alerts and recent games, with an optional copy of your friends, followers, following and groups
The copyright holder is now Miko
The app is now free software under the GNU GPL v3 (LICENSE added, shown in Settings on PC and phone)
The Info page is now called Settings (Preferences and Updates) on PC and phone, so it is easier to find
Cleaner code: unused imports removed
Discover: server browser, favorites, recently viewed, friends in games
Play checks that a Roblox launcher is installed and offers to install it (Linux command, Windows download page, Android Play Store)
Security review: Roblox text is escaped, join codes are validated, hardened Android login view, pinned and hashed Windows libraries, private state folder
Fewer errors after an update on Windows: the app forgets old modules and the launcher asks to restart
Fixed the error "Client object has no attribute group_search_members" (and any like it) after an update on Windows: old and new files could be mixed in memory
After an update the launcher now says so and asks to restart to complete the update (Restart now / No)
The app clears any leftover old modules at start, and the member search falls back instead of failing
New checks make sure every call the app makes to its own parts exists

Groups: only what your role allows is shown (buttons and pages you have no permission for are not there) and it is checked again when you act; you can only give roles below your own and only change, remove or ban members below your rank
Groups: pressing Load more again and again no longer lists people several times; searching a username also finds members that Load more has not reached
VIP servers: the game look-up is a page of its own instead of a bar across the bottom
The update check says which channel it is about, and when Beta has nothing newer than Stable

Admin: unban works like ban: select someone in the list or type an id or username, see their profile and what the ban says (when, by whom, why), add an optional note and answer an Are you sure question; only Yes, unban lets them back in
A ban can only be lifted by someone with at least the role of whoever placed it, and nobody unbans themselves
Forced updates: a version that has missed two updates cannot be used until it is updated; a page covers the app (PC and phone) with an Update now button, and nothing is signed out or deleted
The decision comes from a new signed file in the repository (the list of versions released to everybody); beta versions are never locked
Staff List and ban confirmation fixes carried over from the earlier betas

Admin: a ban needs a reason, and before banning the person's Roblox profile (picture, names, joined, followers, following, friends, description) is shown with the reason and an Are you sure question; only Yes bans, Cancel changes nothing
Fixed text that was cut off with wider Windows fonts (Updates channel names, Admin hints)
PC: a button collapses the side bar to icons, and every group (Social, Roblox, Tools, Staff) folds with an arrow; both are remembered
PC: a reload button in the page header, the beta label in the side bar, a stray line under the sub tabs is gone
Phone: sections fold with an arrow (More, Settings, Home accounts), More is grouped, the top bar says what the page is for, the Robux tile stands out
Fixed text that was cut off on the Admin page with wider fonts

New Beta channel in Settings (PC) and Info > Updates (phone): get every new version before it goes to everybody else; you can go back to Stable at any time and keep your version until Stable catches up
Beta versions are published on a beta branch and as GitHub pre-releases, and the same tested build is later made the stable one
Fixed: the Windows updater could not read release tags with five numbers

Versions now have five numbers: R.B.S.F.D = complete rework . big feature change . small feature change . bug fix . design rework; every update raises exactly one by 1 and they never go down (only a rework resets the others)
Phone: the Staff List (everybody) and an Admin overview (admin role and higher) are under More, using the same signed role list as the PC
The updates are compared number by number (1.7.0 counts as 1.7.0.0.0)
New Staff List page for everybody: the staff in hierarchy order (owner, co-owner, senior admin, admin, trusted friend) with their Roblox profiles and a Go to profile button
New Admin page for admins and up: ban and unban by user id or username with a reason, under a role hierarchy (nobody acts on themselves or on the same or a higher role)
Roles are a signed list (dist/roles.json) that the apps download like the ban list
Fixed text that was cut off in a narrow window on Windows (shorter hints, buttons that wrap)
Phone: fixed a small stray box at the top left of every page
New look on the PC: a side bar with the pages in groups and their counts, a page title with a help line, and the account switch on top
Search everything with Ctrl+K: pages, settings, accounts, and the friends, groups and VIP servers that are loaded (Ctrl+1 to 8 open the pages, F5 reloads)
New look on the phone: a bottom bar (Home, People, Groups, VIP servers, More), a search for pages and settings, and an account switch on every page
Faster: pages on the phone keep what they loaded instead of asking Roblox again each time you come back; tables fill faster on the PC
The window can be made much smaller: a page that does not fit scrolls instead of forcing the window wide
The side bar shrinks to icons in a narrow window
Fixed the Android app crashing at start on phones with Android 12 or older (a signature check used a function only Android 13 has); it was introduced with the ban list in 1.4.0
The ban check can no longer crash the app, whatever goes wrong
Android lint now runs in the automatic checks
Windows installer and uninstaller now show live details: every folder created or deleted and every file with its size, plus totals
Windows installer: choose the folder, optional Start menu entry and desktop icon, default location in %APPDATA%
New: a real Windows installer (Roblox-Manager-Setup.exe): choose where to install, optional Start menu entry (findable with the Windows key) and desktop icon, listed in Apps with an uninstaller
Default install location is inside %APPDATA%
The portable zip is still available
New: ban list. The maintainer can ban a Roblox user id with a reason; a banned account is signed out and removed at once, even in a running session
The ban list is signed with the release key and checked in all three apps (Linux, Windows, Android)
Nothing about you is sent when the list is checked
Fixed cut-off text on the Windows version: table headers, buttons and Settings now fit with Windows fonts
Repository now accepts pull requests (see CONTRIBUTING.md) with protected branches, security policy and automatic checks
New: Windows version (Windows 10 and 11, own Python included, installer script, signed automatic updates)
Windows logins are encrypted with Windows data protection (DPAPI)
Settings and Updates pages adapt to narrow windows and wider fonts
Linux, Windows and Android now share one signed release process
Fixed texts and buttons being cut off at the edge of the Settings and Updates pages in a narrow window
New Info tab with Settings and Updates, and an update log that says what changed in each version
Update log is built into both the Linux and Android apps
Install guides for Linux and Android in the README
Each release now includes the Android APK, a Linux package and checksums on GitHub
The Linux installer points at the GitHub update server by default
Both apps now update from the public GitHub repository
The Android app has the update address built in
New: the Android app (Home, People, Groups, VIP servers, Money, Request log, Settings) with password, 2-step, browser and cookie sign-in
Android logins are encrypted with the Android Keystore
One signed release process for the Linux and Android apps
First version delivered by the automatic updater
Linux desktop app: friends, requests, followers, following and blocked lists; groups; VIP servers; Robux and transactions; request log; API explorer
Several accounts, with sign-in by password and 2-step, browser or cookie; logins kept encrypted in the system wallet
Requests follow Roblox's rate limits, with progress and a Stop button for long batches
Automatic updates at every start, only from commits signed with the release key, with a way back to the previous version
